title: The Raindrop That Took a Trip
intro: This quiz follows Kavya and Ben as they learn how water moves through the water cycle.

questions.prompt: What did Kavya notice sliding down the classroom window?
questions.explanation: Kavya noticed a raindrop sliding down the classroom window.

choices: Liquid water changing into water vapor and rising into the air
Water collecting in lakes and oceans
questions.explanation: Evaporation is when liquid water changes into water vapor and rises into the air.

choices: Water vapor cools and changes into tiny liquid droplets
questions.explanation: During condensation, water vapor cools and changes into tiny liquid droplets.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an example of precipitation?
choices: Rain, snow, sleet, or hail falling from clouds
Water vapor rising into the air
questions.explanation: Precipitation includes rain, snow, sleet, or hail falling from clouds.

questions.prompt: Why does the water cycle continue again and again?
choices: The Sun heats collected water, causing it to evaporate again
questions.explanation: The water cycle continues because the Sun heats collected water, causing it to evaporate again.
